notes: Fictional subscriber-level simulator with random cohort effects, person engagement frailty, permanent human/bot status, varying cohort contactability lifetimes, unique responders and repeat events. Mechanism scenarios are isolated: CPC-only squeeze, CPL-only increase, or human/bot deterioration. Development seed differs from held-out worlds. Sequential decision uses one fixed acquired cohort at weekly as-of cutoffs with a two-cent-per-lead age-180 margin buffer and 5%/95% posterior thresholds; it is a classification replay, not an optimized wait/buy policy. Calendar response and CPC can stabilize, so continued trend is a separate conditional future policy, not hidden future truth. Repeated targets/cutoffs within a world are correlated. Evaluation tests an approximate model against a richer synthetic generator; implementation checks do not imply calibration.
